Package uni.insubria.theknife.backend.ws

package uni.insubria.theknife.backend.ws
  • Class
    Description
    Broadcaster
    Sends server-initiated EVENT envelopes to connected clients, so that changes made by one client (new review, owner reply, restaurant add/edit/delete) appear in real time on the others.
    ConnectionRegistry
    Tracks the currently open WebSocket connections and their per-connection ConnectionState.
    ConnectionState
    Per-connection authentication state.
    Dispatcher
    Routes a parsed request Envelope to the handler responsible for its action.
    HandlerResult
    Outcome of handling a request: the RESPONSE to send back to the caller, plus an optional EVENT to broadcast to the other clients after the transaction commits.
    TheKnifeSocket
    The single WebSocket endpoint of TheKnife backend.
